audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Tryndamere six of seven stages while the prose calls level 6 'your first real foothold' and says Sunfire pushes you past his spin-kite pattern.
audit.why: The whys and the chart disagree in the same view; the packet stage read matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item set to Sejuani, two items set to Skill; Tryndamere keeps levels 1 through 5, which the 46.15% figure supports.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undying Rage is given a '110s cooldown' in two separate fields.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80. There is no rank at which it is 110, so a player counting 110 steps up ten seconds early at rank 1 and walks into a five-second immortality window.
audit.corrected: Written as 120 seconds at rank 1 in whys[5] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Outranges Spinning Slash' is asserted with no numbers, and Mocking Shout does not appear anywhere in either layer.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 1300 against Spinning Slash's 650 — that is a full 650-unit gap and it is the entire reason level 6 is your foothold. Mocking Shout cuts your attack damage and slows you only if your back is turned, and Frost Armor grants slow immunity, so the slow half of it does nothing to an out-of-combat Sejuani. Both facts change how the player stands.
audit.corrected: 1300 against 650 written into whys[4]; Mocking Shout and Frost Armor's slow immunity written into whys[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal despite Bloodlust being his sustain engine.
audit.why: Bloodlust converts Fury into healing and scales his attack damage as he drops low, so an un-shredded Tryndamere heals back through exactly the window your stun chain opens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields state Undying Rage lasts five seconds.
audit.why: Riot's description gives no duration, and I have no local source that does. The claim may well be right but I will not certify it.
audit.corrected: Left in place untouched; recorded in unverified.

edits.after: No power spike for you at 4-5 while his crits climb; Mocking Shout saps your attack damage, but its slow cannot touch Frost Armor — never turn your back, and keep the wave frozen.
edits.before: No meaningful power spike for you at 4-5 while his crit damage climbs; respect Spinning Slash range and keep the wave frozen so he cannot all-in without jungler vision.

edits.after: Glacial Prison is a 1300-range projectile against Spinning Slash's 650 — it stuns him before Undying Rage can be cast at all, and it is the first moment you dictate the fight.
edits.before: Glacial Prison gives you a ranged CC projectile that outranges Spinning Slash and can lock him out of his Undying Rage window — first moment you can dictate the fight.

edits.after: Sunfire Aegis raises your contact damage and HP buffer past the point his spin-kite pattern can chunk you, and Undying Rage is 120 seconds at rank 1, a window you count and punish.
edits.before: Sunfire Aegis raises your contact damage and HP buffer past the point his spin-kite pattern can chunk you, and Undying Rage is on a 110s cooldown you can track and punish.

edits.after: Glacial Prison is your first real agency: 1300 range against his 650 spin, and a stun landed before he casts Undying Rage denies it outright.
edits.before: Glacial Prison is your first real agency: a long-range comet that can CC him out of an Undying Rage window or lock him for your jungler.

edits.after: Sunfire Aegis lets you survive his spin-kite pattern and punish the post-Undying Rage window, which at rank 1 leaves him 120 seconds with no backup.
edits.before: Sunfire Aegis lets you survive his spin-kite pattern and punish a post-Undying Rage window where he is on a 110s cooldown with no backup.

edits.after: Time Spinning Slash (E), 12 seconds at rank 1, to close the moment your Arctic Assault is down
edits.before: Time Spinning Slash (E) to close on you the moment your Q is on cooldown so you cannot escape

edits.after: Your CC chain becomes genuinely terrifying in teamfights where your team can follow the lockdown, but Undying Rage means a solo execution is almost never clean — he survives, spins out, and Bloodlust heals him back, so somebody has to carry Grievous Wounds. Play around objectives: land Glacial Prison on the group, chain Permafrost, and let your damage dealers close while the storm still holds him. Never blow your R on Tryndamere alone when his ult is available; save it for the fight where your follow-up can actually convert once it expires.
edits.before: Your CC chain becomes genuinely terrifying in teamfights where your team can follow the lockdown, but Tryndamere's Undying Rage means a solo execution is almost never clean — he survives, spins out, and heals back. Play around objectives: land Glacial Prison on the group, chain Permafrost, and let your damage dealers close while he is still stunned from the blizzard zone. Never blow your R on Tryndamere alone when his ult is available; save it for the fight where your follow-up can actually convert after the five seconds expire.

notes: Undying Rage was printed as a '110s cooldown' in two fields — it is 120/100/80, and 110 is not a rank at any point, so a player counting it steps up ten seconds early into an immortality window. Added the two numbers that make level 6 legible: Glacial Prison 1300 against Spinning Slash 650. Mocking Shout was missing from both layers entirely, which matters because it saps your attack damage while its slow does nothing through Frost Armor's slow immunity. UNVERIFIED, LEFT IN PLACE: spikes[3] and mid both state Undying Rage lasts five seconds. Riot's description gives no duration and I had no local source to confirm it, so I did not touch that text and did not repeat the number in anything I wrote.
